labels.what: If VITE_SUPABASE_* are missing, the app silently connects to the maintainer's own Supabase project; a self-hoster's finance data would go to someone else's database
Supabase URL and publishable key written in code as fallback; public by design
VAPID public key hardcoded as a fallback when VITE_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY is not set (public key, but ties push to the maintainer's keypair)
No supabase/migrations folder in the repo: table definitions and row level security policies are not visible or reviewable; the README claims RLS protects every table
The public /demo reads the same real tables as the signed-in app through an anonymous client, so those tables must allow anonymous reads; policy not visible in repo
Demo pages reuse the real pages against whatever anonymous data the database returns, described as 'sample data'; no seed or fixture file in the repo
Login check runs only in the browser (ssr: false, beforeLoad); real protection depends on database policies, not on the route
Session tokens stored in localStorage and shared with framing parent windows by postMessage; origin list includes http://localhost:3000 in dev
Allowed parent origins (lovable.dev, gptengineer.app, localhost:3000) hardcoded
